node.title: Re: Match similar words in file name
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: See my node [id://1179840] for a short tutorial on this. Also, I see you're using [doc://glob], be aware that [id://1206848|it has several caveats], for example in this case if $dir happens to have any whitespace or [doc://glob] metacharacters in it, it will not do what you want. I mention several alternatives in that link.
